“Ah... Good morning.”
“Good morning, Kasumi.”
“You're up early, huh?”
“Yeah, I was thinking of making porridge with the leftover rice from last night.”
“Do you guys like porridge, Kasumi?”
“Yep, we're not picky. Whatever you cook is fine!”
“That's great. I was worried you might not like it.”
“Haha... After tasting your cooking, I'm looking forward to whatever you make!”
“Leave it to me! I'll make sure you have a nice, satisfying breakfast!”
“But honestly, I thought there was a burglar in here for a second.”
“A burglar?”
“Someone rummaging around the kitchen so early. Not used to that.”
“But after smelling those delicious aromas, I realized it was you, {Me}}.”
“Sorry, I guess I should've let you know first?”
“It's fine. Like I said yesterday, feel free to use anything.”
“I'm just not used to someone else making breakfast, that's all.”
“So, Kasumi, you usually cook?”
“Yeah, but I'm not that good...”
“My breakfast is alright. I'll make rice balls or toast and eggs, but dinner is a disaster...”
“How about lunch? And are you... going to church today?”
“We usually make extra for breakfast and take it as a packed lunch to the church.”
“I see. I'll make some rice balls then.”
“Thank you!”
“Um... Can I ask you something?”
“Sure, what's up?”
“What exactly does a nun do?”
“Huh? I told you yesterday.”
“We chat with the neighbors here, look after the kids, stuff like that. That's about it.”
“But I can see why we might not fit the part.”
“I guess I'm asking... What's with the outfits?”
“Oh, that...”
“The priest here is a really kind old man.”
“But he had to take a break recently because of a back injury.”
“So we came here to help out.”
“It's a long story, but basically...”
“It's like a punishment.”
“Punishment?”
“Ayano and Shizuku did some stuff that our dad didn't approve of, so he sent us back here to cool off.”
“But it just so happened the priest hurt his back, so we stepped in to help at the church.”
“I go with them 'cuz I'd worry if it was just the two of them.”
“So this is your hometown?”
“Yeah, it's been a while since we've been back.”
“Ha. You still seem a bit confused. How about this—”
“Ugh... Morning... Kasumi, {Me}...”
“Huh?”
“Ahhh—Ayano, why are you dressed like that?!”
“Oh... Forgot to put on clothes after taking off my pajamas...”
“Go get dressed right now!”
“I haven't even brushed my teeth yet...”
“Let's go together, and don't forget, {Me} is staying here now!”
“Sorry about that—making you see something you shouldn't have.”
“Let's all go to the church together this afternoon, I'll show you around!”
“Sounds good.”
“Alright, this way!”
“Fine...”
“Good thing... I was facing the other way...”
